contentBlocks.title: Guqula Ikhadi Legolide le-SASSA — Uhlobo Lwe-Black Card
contentBlocks.description: I-Postbank iguqule ikhadi ngalinye le-SASSA Gold nge-Postbank Black Card entsha. Isikhathi sokugcina sokuguqula bekungu-31 August 2026, futhi amakhadi e-Gold ayekile ukusebenza ngemva kosuku lowo. Uma ungakaguquli, imali yakho ivikeleke — thatha i-Black Card yakho manje. Ukuguqula kuyamahhala, kuthatha imizuzu, futhi kudinga i-ID yakho yeNingizimu Afrika kuphela.

contentBlocks.title: Amakhadi e-Gold Ayekile Ukusebenza
contentBlocks.text: Isikhathi sokugcina sika-31 August 2026 siphelile futhi i-Postbank yaqinisekisa ukuthi ngeke kunjalo. Amakhadi e-Gold ayekisiwe — uma ungakaguquli, awunakufinyelela imali yakho kuze kube yini uthatha i-Black Card. Ungaxhawuli: imali yakho isephephile ku-akhawunti yakho ye-Postbank futhi ukuguqula kunoma yiphi indawo kuyamahhala.

I-Postbank isusa kancane kancane ikhadi le-SASSA elidala legolide iyifake enye entsha i-Postbank Black Card njengengxenye yokuvuselela uhlelo lokukhokhelwa izinhlelo zokusekela abantu kuleli. I-Black Card isebenza ku-ATMs eyengeziwe, isekela izinkokhelo ezingathinti, futhi inokuvikelwa okuthuthukile. Ngemva kuka-31 August 2026 amakhadi e-Gold adala azoekisiwa.

steps.title: Qoqa i-ID yakho
steps.description: Thatha incwadi yakho ye-ID yeNingizimu Afrika esebenzayo noma i-smart ID card. I-ID yesikhashana iyamkelekile. AWUDINGI ikhadi yakho endala legolide ukuze uthole entsha.

steps.title: Thola indawo yokuthatha eduze kunakho konke
steps.description: Shaya *120*355# kucingo lakho ukuze uthole indawo yokuthatha eduze kunakho konke, noma usho ku-Postbank ku-0800 53 54 55. Ungathatha kunoma yisiphi isifunda, noma ube naphi lapho i-grant yakho yamukelwe.

steps.title: Vakashela indawo ye-Postbank noma isitolo esihlanganyelayo
steps.description: Amakhadi atholakala ezindaweni ze-Postbank ngaphakathi kwamastoro ahlanganyelayo e-Shoprite, Checkers, Usave, Pick n Pay, Boxer ne-Spar kulo lonke ilizwe.

steps.title: Thatha i-Black Card yakho
steps.description: Ukuguqula kuyamahhala ngokuphelele futhi kuthatha imizuzu embalwa. Akukho mafomu adingekayo futhi akukho ukuvula okudingekayo — ikhadi isebenza ngokushesha uma inikiwe.

steps.title: Hlola ibhalansi yakho ethunyelwe
steps.description: Noma yiluphi uhlobo lwemali kulikhadi lakho elidala legolide luyishintsha ngokuzenzakalelayo kwi-Black Card entsha. Ungalilahli ikhadi endala ngaphambi kokuthi uqinisekise ukuthi ibhalansi yakho isidlulisiwe.

contentBlocks.title: Ukuguqula Kuyamahhala
contentBlocks.text: I-SASSA ne-Postbank azizange zikhole i-Black Card swap. Uma umuntu ekucela ukukhokha, ugcwale ifomu, noma unikeze i-PIN noma i-OTP ukuze uthole ikhadi, unomuntu ozokukhohlisa. I-Black Card yangempela inokuthi 'Postbank' ebhalwe ngaphambili.

contentBlocks.title: Thola Indawo Yokuthatha Eduze
contentBlocks.text: Shaya *120*355# kunoma yisiphi iselula ukuze uthole indawo yokuthatha ikhadi ye-Postbank eduze kunakho konke. Iseviso isebenza kuzo zonke inethiwekhi ezinkulu zaseNingizimu Afrika. Ungasho futhi ku-Postbank ku-0800 53 54 55.

Abakhohlisi bajubese abathengi ngesikhathi sokuguqulwa kwekhadi. Khumbula: i-Black Card yangempela inokuthi 'Postbank' ebhalwe ngaphambili njalo. Uma ikhadi lingasho i-Postbank, iyabhexa. I-SASSA ne-Postbank ngeke zicela i-PIN yakho, i-OTP, noma inombolo yebhange, futhi akukho muntu ongakukhokhela ukuguqula ikhadi yakho.

contentBlocks.text: Ukusebenzisa i-Black Card yakho nsuku zonke

I-Black Card isebenza kunoma yisiphi i-ATM noma endaweni yokukhokha ethola i-Mastercard, futhi ungathola imali ngemahhala ezitolo ezihlanganyelayo (Shoprite, Checkers, Pick n Pay, Boxer, Usave) nama-ATM e-Postbank. Akukho mikhondo yanyanga, futhi ikhadi isekela izinkokhelo ezingathinti ezitolo ezamkela amakhadi.

contentBlocks.title: Ikhadi elilahlekile noma ebuntfweni?
contentBlocks.text: Bika manje ku-Postbank ku-0800 53 54 55 ukuze ikhadi ibanjwe. Bese uvakashela noma yiphi indawo ye-Postbank ne-ID yakho ukuze uthole esinye. Izinkokhelo ze-grant yakho ziqhubeka njalo — imali ihlala ku-akhawunti yakho ye-Postbank ngisho nangalesi sikhathi.

Uma ikhadi lakho legolide selingasebenzi ngemva kuka-31 August 2026, lokhu kujwayelekile futhi akukho lutho olungaphuthelwe nge-grant yakho. Imali yakho ayilahlekile — ihlala ku-akhawunti yakho ye-Postbank. Kufanele uthathe i-Black Card yakho nje. Ukuguqula kusayamahhala futhi kusathatha imizuzu kunoma yiphi indawo, nangemva kwesikhathi sokugcina.

steps.title: Ungxhawuli — imali yakho isephephile
steps.description: Izinkokhelo ze-grant yakho nanoma yiluphi uhlobo lwemali kulikhadi lakho endala zihlala ku-akhawunti yakho ye-Postbank. Ikuphela ikhadi kuphela ekisiwe.

steps.title: Thola indawo yokuthatha
steps.description: Shaya *120*355# kucingo lakho, noma usho ku-Postbank ku-0800 53 54 55, ukuze uthole indawo ye-Postbank eduze kunakho konke noma isitolo esihlanganyelayo.

steps.title: Thatha i-Black Card yakho ne-ID
steps.description: Vakashela indawo yokuthatha ne-ID yakho yeNingizimu Afrika (incwadi noma i-smart ID). Akukho ikhadi endala, akukho mafomu, akukho mikhondo. I-Black Card isebenza ngokushesha uma inikiwe.

contentBlocks.title: Ngesikhathi Esifanayo, Isashesha — Ngemva Kwesikhathi Sokugcina
contentBlocks.text: Ukulahlekelwa isikhathi sokugcina akukubolekisi lutho ngaphezu kwalokho, futhi awujwayelwa noma ubophezeleke. I-Postbank iqhubeka nokunika amakhadi e-Black ngemva kuka-31 Agasti. Isiphetho esisodwa ukuthi ikhadi lakho elidala legolide lihlala ekisiwe kuze kube yini uthatha ikhadi entsha.

faqs.question: Ngilahlekelwe isikhathi sokugcina sika-31 August 2026. Ngiyakuthola yini i-Black Card?
faqs.answer: Yebo. I-Postbank iqhubeka nokunika amakhadi e-Black ngemva kwesikhathi sokugcina. Imali yakho isephephile ku-akhawunti yakho ye-Postbank — thatha i-Black Card yakho ne-ID yakho kunoma yiphi indawo yokuthatha futhi isebenza ngokushesha. Akukho mikhondo noma isijwayelo sokuguqula kamuva.

faqs.question: Ikhadi legolide liyekile ukusebenza. Imali yami iphelile?
faqs.answer: Cha. Imali yakho ayilahlekile futhi i-grant yakho ayithintekile. Ikhadi ekisiwe ivimba ukufinyelela kuphela — ibhalansi yakho nezinkokhelo ezizayo zihlala zivikeleke ku-akhawunti yakho ye-Postbank kuze kube yini uthatha i-Black Card.

faqs.question: Ukuguqulwa kwe-Black Card kuhamba nangamali?
faqs.answer: Cha. Ukufakwa kuyamahhala ngokuphelele. Akukho mafomu, akukho mikhondo, akukho ukuvula okudingekayo. Uma umuntu ekucela ukukhokhela ikhadi, iyabhexa.

faqs.question: Ngidinga ukuletha ikhadi yami yegolide ukuze ngiguqule?
faqs.answer: Cha. Kufanele uthathe i-ID yakho yeNingizimu Afrika noma i-ID yesikhashana kuphela. Noma yiluphi uhlobo lwemali kulikhadi lakho legolide luyishintsha ngokuzenzakalelayo kwi-Black Card entsha.

faqs.question: Ngiyakuthola yini i-Black Card yami esifundweni esahlukile kunalapho i-grant yakho yamukelwe?
faqs.answer: Yebo. Amakhadi atholakala kunoma yiphi indawo ye-Postbank noma isitolo esihlanganyelayo kunoma yisiphi isifunda, noma ngabe i-grant yakho yamukelwe kuphi.

faqs.question: Kwenzeke nini uma ikhadi legolide ilahlekile noma ebuntfweni ngaphambi kokuguqula?
faqs.answer: Bika ku-Postbank ku-0800 53 54 55 ukuze ikhadi ibanjwe, bese uvakashela noma yiphi indawo ye-Postbank ne-ID yakho ukuze uthathe i-Black Card. Izinkokhelo ze-grant yakho ziqhubeka njalo ngalesi sikhathi.

faqs.question: Ngiyithola kanjani indawo yokuthatha i-Black Card eduze?
faqs.answer: Shaya *120*355# kucingo lakho ukuze uthole indawo yokuthatha eduze kunakho konke, noma usho ku-Postbank ku-0800 53 54 55. Amakhadi atholakala ezindaweni ze-Postbank ngaphakathi kwamastoro akhethiwe e-Shoprite, Checkers, Usave, Pick n Pay, Boxer ne-Spar.
